message.content:
You can split the string only once (at the first `=`) so that everything after the first separator stays together:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`split('=', 1)` tells Python to split on `'='` but only perform one split, leaving the remainder (`"good="`) intact.
